content.definition: Diluted EPS shows EPS that would result if all potentially dilutive securities were converted to common stock
content.purpose: Warns investors of potential dilution from conversion of securities (options, warrants, convertible bonds, convertible preferred)
content.formula: Diluted EPS = (Net Income - Preferred Dividends + Adjustments) / (Weighted Avg Shares + Dilutive Potential Shares)

treasury_stock_method.assumption: Options/warrants exercised at beginning of year (or grant date if later). Proceeds used to buy back shares at average market price.
steps: 1. Calculate shares issued upon exercise (number of options × 1)
2. Calculate proceeds from exercise (number of options × exercise price)
3. Calculate shares repurchased (proceeds / average market price)
4. Net shares added to denominator = Shares issued - Shares repurchased
treasury_stock_method.formula: Incremental shares = Options × (1 - (Exercise price / Average market price))
treasury_stock_method.only_if_dilutive: Include only if exercise price < average market price (options are 'in the money'). If exercise price > market price, options are antidilutive (ignore).

if_converted_method.used_for: Convertible bonds and convertible preferred stock

convertible_bonds.numerator_adjustment: Add back interest expense (net of tax) that would not have been paid if converted
convertible_bonds.denominator_adjustment: Add shares that would be issued upon conversion
convertible_bonds.formula: Add to numerator: Interest expense × (1 - tax rate). Add to denominator: Shares from conversion.

convertible_preferred.numerator_adjustment: Add back preferred dividends (that were subtracted in basic EPS)
convertible_preferred.denominator_adjustment: Add shares that would be issued upon conversion
convertible_preferred.note: No tax effect on preferred dividends (dividends not deductible)

if_converted_method.assumption: Conversion occurred at beginning of year (or issuance date if later)

antidilution.definition: Security that would INCREASE EPS if included (rather than decrease). Antidilutive securities EXCLUDED from diluted EPS.
antidilution.test: If including security increases EPS, it's antidilutive (don't include)
antidilution.rule: Diluted EPS must be LESS THAN OR EQUAL TO basic EPS (never higher)

calculation_example_1_options.facts: Basic EPS $5.00. Net income $500K. Weighted avg shares 100,000. Stock options outstanding: 10,000 options, exercise price $20. Average market price $25.

calculation_example_2_convertible_bonds.facts: Basic EPS $4.00. Net income $400K. Weighted avg shares 100,000. Convertible bonds: $1M face, 6% interest, convertible into 20,000 common shares. Tax rate 30%.

calculation_example_3_convertible_prefer.facts: Net income $500K. Preferred dividends $50K. Weighted avg shares 100,000. Basic EPS $4.50. Convertible preferred: Convertible into 15,000 common shares.

calculation_example_4_multiple_securitie.facts: Net income $600K. No preferred. Weighted avg shares 100,000. Basic EPS $6.00. (A) Options: 5,000, exercise $30, avg market $40. (B) Convertible bonds: $500K face, 8%, convertible to 10,000 shares, tax 30%.
calculation_example_4_multiple_securitie.order_of_inclusion: Include most dilutive first. Options: $5.926. Bonds: $5.709. Bonds more dilutive.

antidilution_example.facts: Net income $100K. Weighted avg shares 20,000. Basic EPS $5.00. Convertible preferred: $30K dividends, converts to 3,000 shares.
antidilution_example.conclusion: $4.35 > $3.50 → ANTIDILUTIVE → Exclude from diluted EPS. Diluted EPS = $3.50 (same as basic).

contingently_issuable_shares.definition: Shares issuable upon meeting certain conditions (e.g., earnings targets, stock price targets)
contingently_issuable_shares.include_if: Conditions have been met as of end of reporting period
contingently_issuable_shares.do_not_include_if: Conditions not yet met (even if likely to be met in future)

year_to_date_calculation.interim_periods: For interim reporting, use year-to-date weighted average, not just quarterly
year_to_date_calculation.average_market_price: Use average market price for the period (year-to-date for annual, YTD for interim)

cpa_exam_tips: Diluted EPS ≤ Basic EPS (if diluted > basic, it's antidilutive - exclude it)
Treasury stock method: Options/warrants. Formula: Options × (1 - Exercise/Market). Only if in the money (exercise < market).
If-converted method: Convertible bonds/preferred. Add back interest (net of tax) or dividends, add shares.
Test each security individually for dilution. Include only dilutive securities.
When multiple securities: Include most dilutive first, retest others sequentially.
Convertible bonds: Tax-effect the interest add-back. Convertible preferred: No tax effect on dividends.

calculation_approach: - Convertible bonds: Add interest × (1-tax), add shares
- Convertible preferred: Add dividends, add shares
3. Calculate diluted EPS including each security
4. Exclude any antidilutive securities (those that increase EPS)
5. If multiple securities: Include most dilutive first, retest sequentially

quick_formulas.options_incremental_shares: Options × (Market price - Exercise price) / Market price

cpa_exam_strategies.antidilution_test: If (Basic EPS numerator + Adjustment) / (Basic EPS denominator + Added shares) > Basic EPS → Antidilutive (exclude)
common_mistakes: Including antidilutive securities (remember: diluted EPS must be ≤ basic EPS)
Forgetting tax effect on convertible bond interest add-back
Including options that are out of the money (exercise price > market price)
Not testing securities sequentially when multiple potentially dilutive securities exist
Using wrong average market price for treasury stock method

key_points: Diluted EPS shows potential dilution from conversion of securities
Treasury stock method: Options/warrants (if in the money). Incremental shares = Options × (1 - Exercise/Market)
If-converted method: Convertible bonds (add interest net of tax, add shares), Convertible preferred (add dividends, add shares)
Exclude antidilutive securities (those that would increase EPS)
Test multiple securities sequentially, include most dilutive first
